paragraphs.text: From electronic to folk, jazz and classical, this festival is renowned for bringing world-class musicians to this historical city. Starting with a great night of free music, 'Party in the City this year is going to be no exception.
paragraphs.translation:
从电子音乐到民谣、爵士乐和古典音乐，这个节日以将世界级音乐家带到这座历史名城而闻名。
从一场精彩的免费音乐之夜开始，今年的“城市派对”也不例外。

paragraphs.text: B The Great Escape
paragraphs.translation: B 大逃亡音乐节

paragraphs.text: Often referred to as Europe's leading festival for new music, more than 300 bands will perform to around 10,000 people in 30-plus venues, meaning you're sure to see the next big thing in music.
paragraphs.translation: 该音乐节常被誉为欧洲领先的新音乐节，将有超过300支乐队在30多个场馆为约一万人演出，这意味着你一定会看到下一个音乐界的巨星。

paragraphs.text: C Springwatch Festival
paragraphs.translation: C 春季观察节

paragraphs.text: The much loved television series Springwatch celebrates the countryside as it does every year, with sheep herding, wood carving demonstrations, insect hunts and more activities, accompanied by live music and a great farmers' market, offering all sorts of mouth-watering produce.
paragraphs.translation: 深受喜爱的电视系列节目《春之守望》每年都会像往常一样颂扬乡村风光，活动包括牧羊、木雕演示、昆虫搜寻等，同时伴有现场音乐和大型农贸市场，提供各种令人垂涎的美食。

paragraphs.text: D Wychwood Music Festival
paragraphs.translation: D 威奇伍德音乐节

paragraphs.text: Rightly nominated for the best family festival award every year since it began in 2005,this festival offers a combination of different music genres - many featuring artists from around the Wychwood area - and comedy, alongside a selection of outdoor cafés serving amazing world foods.
paragraphs.translation: 自2005年创办以来，该节每年都当之无愧地入围最佳家庭节奖，它融合了多种音乐风格（其中许多以来自威奇伍德地区的艺术家为特色）和喜剧元素，同时还设有一系列提供美味国际美食的户外咖啡馆。

paragraphs.text: E Love Food Festival
paragraphs.translation: E 爱美食节

paragraphs.text: Bringing together a selection of the finest produce, this festival aims to educate visitors about how food should be produced and where it should come from, through sampling a range of tasty treats, cooked on site.
paragraphs.translation: 这个节日汇聚了精选的优质农产品，旨在通过现场烹饪品尝一系列美味佳肴，来教育游客食物应当如何生产以及来自何处。

paragraphs.text: F The 3 Wishes Faery Festival
paragraphs.translation: F 三愿望仙子节

paragraphs.text: The UK's most magical event, this is a three-day festival of folk art, live music and fashion shows set in the beautiful wild surroundings of Bodmin Moor. If you don't fancy taking a tent, some local residents usually offer to put visitors up.
paragraphs.translation:
这是英国最具魔力的活动，是一个为期三天的节日，包含民间艺术、现场音乐和时装秀，举办地点在博德明荒原美丽的自然环境中。
如果你不想带帐篷，一些当地居民通常会提供住宿给游客。

paragraphs.text: G Bath International Dance Festival
paragraphs.translation: G 巴斯国际舞蹈节

paragraphs.text: Featuring demonstrations from world champion dancers and stars from the TV series Strictly Come Dancing, the festival promises toe-tapping action, including a world-record attempt, where everyone is invited to join in.
paragraphs.translation: 该音乐节将呈现世界冠军舞者及电视系列剧《舞动奇迹》明星的表演，保证带来令人随节奏起舞的精彩活动，其中包括一项世界纪录挑战，并邀请所有人共同参与。

paragraphs.text: BIG ROCK CLIMBING CENTRE
paragraphs.translation: 大岩石攀岩中心

paragraphs.text: Big Rock Climbing Centre is a modern, friendly, professionally run centre offering over 1,250 square metres of fantastic indoor climbing. We use trained and experienced instructors to give you the opportunity to learn and develop climbing skills, keep fit and have fun.Master our 11 m-high climbing walls, using a rope harness, for an unbeatable sense of achievement.Or experience the thrills of climbing without any harness in our special low-level arena, which has foam mats on the floor to cushion any fall safely.
paragraphs.translation:
大岩石攀岩中心
大岩石攀岩中心是一个现代化、友好且专业运营的中心，提供超过1250平方米的极佳室内攀岩场地。
我们使用训练有素且经验丰富的教练，为您提供学习和发展攀岩技能、保持健康和享受乐趣的机会。
使用绳索安全带征服我们11米高的攀岩墙，获得无与伦比的成就感。
或者在我们特殊的低层区域体验无安全带的攀岩刺激，该区域地面铺有泡沫垫，可安全缓冲任何坠落。

paragraphs.text: Who is Big Rock for?
paragraphs.translation: 大岩石攀岩中心面向哪些人群？

paragraphs.text: Almost anyone can enjoy Big Rock. Previous climbing experience and specialist equipment are not required.You can come on your own or with friends and family.Come as a fun alternative to the gym or for a special day out with the kids. If you're visiting with friends or family but not climbing, or just fancy coming to look, please feel free to relax in our excellent café overlooking the climbing areas.
paragraphs.translation:
几乎任何人都可以享受大岩石的乐趣。
不需要之前的攀爬经验和专业设备。
你可以独自前来，或与朋友和家人一同前往。
作为健身房的有趣替代品，或与孩子们共度特别的一天。
如果你与朋友或家人来访但不攀爬，或只是想来看看，请随意在我们俯瞰攀爬区的优质咖啡馆里放松身心。

paragraphs.text: Mobile Climbing Wall
paragraphs.translation: 移动攀岩墙

paragraphs.text: Available on a day hire basis at any location, the Big Rock Mobile Climbing Wall is the perfect way to enhance any show, festival or event. The mobile wall can be used indoors or outdoors and features four unique 7.3 m-high climbing faces designed to allow four people to climb simultaneously. Quick to set up and pack up, the Mobile Climbing Wall is staffed by qualified and experienced climbing instructors, providing the opportunity to climb the wall in a controlled and safe environment. When considering what to wear, we've found that trousers and t-shirts are ideal. We will, however, ask people to remove scarves. Most flat shoes are suitable as long as they're enclosed and support the foot.The mobile wall is very adaptable and can be operated in light rain and winds up to 50 kph.There are,however, particular measures that we take in such conditions.
paragraphs.translation:
移动攀岩墙
Big Rock移动攀岩墙可按日租赁，在任何地点都能使用，是提升任何演出、节日或活动的完美方式。
该移动墙可用于室内或室外，设有四个独特的7.3米高攀岩面，设计可让四人同时攀爬。
移动攀岩墙安装和拆卸迅速，由合格且有经验的攀岩教练负责运营，提供在可控且安全的环境中攀爬的机会。
关于着装，我们发现裤子和T恤是最理想的选择。
然而，我们会要求人们取下围巾。
大多数平底鞋都适合，只要它们是包脚且能支撑足部的。
移动墙适应性很强，可在小雨和风速高达每小时50公里的条件下运行。
不过，在这种情况下，我们会采取特定措施。

paragraphs.text: What about hiring the Mobile Climbing Wall for my school or college?
paragraphs.translation:
移动攀岩墙
租用移动攀岩墙给我的学校或学院怎么样？

paragraphs.text: As climbing is different from the usual team games practised at schools, we've found that some students who don't usually like participating in sports are willing to have a go on the mobile climbing wall.If you're concerned that some children may not want to take part because they feel nervous if they climb, then please be assured that our instructors will support them up to a level which they're comfortable with.They will still benefit greatly from the experience.
paragraphs.translation:
移动攀岩墙
由于攀岩不同于学校常进行的团队运动，我们发现一些通常不喜欢参加体育活动的学生愿意尝试移动攀岩墙。
如果您担心有些孩子可能因攀爬时感到紧张而不愿参加，请放心，我们的教练会支持他们达到自己感到舒适的程度。
他们仍将从这次经历中受益匪浅。

sentence_translations.translation: 该音乐节将呈现世界冠军舞者及电视系列剧《舞动奇迹》明星的表演，保证带来令人随节奏起舞的精彩活动，其中包括一项世界纪录挑战，并邀请所有人共同参与。

sentence_translations.sentence: BIG ROCK CLIMBING CENTRE
sentence_translations.translation: 大岩石攀岩中心

sentence_translations.sentence: Big Rock Climbing Centre is a modern, friendly, professionally run centre offering over 1,250 square metres of fantastic indoor climbing.
sentence_translations.translation: 大岩石攀岩中心是一个现代化、友好且专业运营的中心，提供超过1250平方米的极佳室内攀岩场地。

sentence_translations.sentence: We use trained and experienced instructors to give you the opportunity to learn and develop climbing skills, keep fit and have fun.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们使用训练有素且经验丰富的教练，为您提供学习和发展攀岩技能、保持健康和享受乐趣的机会。

sentence_translations.sentence: Master our 11 m-high climbing walls, using a rope harness, for an unbeatable sense of achievement.
sentence_translations.translation: 使用绳索安全带征服我们11米高的攀岩墙，获得无与伦比的成就感。

sentence_translations.sentence: Or experience the thrills of climbing without any harness in our special low-level arena, which has foam mats on the floor to cushion any fall safely.
sentence_translations.translation: 或者在我们特殊的低层区域体验无安全带的攀岩刺激，该区域地面铺有泡沫垫，可安全缓冲任何坠落。

sentence_translations.sentence: Who is Big Rock for?
sentence_translations.translation: 大岩石攀岩中心面向哪些人群？

sentence_translations.sentence: Almost anyone can enjoy Big Rock.
sentence_translations.translation: 几乎任何人都可以享受大岩石的乐趣。

sentence_translations.sentence: Previous climbing experience and specialist equipment are not required.
sentence_translations.translation: 不需要之前的攀爬经验和专业设备。

sentence_translations.sentence: You can come on your own or with friends and family.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可以独自前来，或与朋友和家人一同前往。

sentence_translations.sentence: Come as a fun alternative to the gym or for a special day out with the kids.
sentence_translations.translation: 作为健身房的有趣替代品，或与孩子们共度特别的一天。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you're visiting with friends or family but not climbing, or just fancy coming to look, please feel free to relax in our excellent café overlooking the climbing areas.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你与朋友或家人来访但不攀爬，或只是想来看看，请随意在我们俯瞰攀爬区的优质咖啡馆里放松身心。

sentence_translations.sentence: Mobile Climbing Wall
sentence_translations.translation: 移动攀岩墙

sentence_translations.sentence: Available on a day hire basis at any location, the Big Rock Mobile Climbing Wall is the perfect way to enhance any show, festival or event.
sentence_translations.translation: Big Rock移动攀岩墙可按日租赁，在任何地点都能使用，是提升任何演出、节日或活动的完美方式。

sentence_translations.sentence: The mobile wall can be used indoors or outdoors and features four unique 7.3 m-high climbing faces designed to allow four people to climb simultaneously.
sentence_translations.translation: 该移动墙可用于室内或室外，设有四个独特的7.3米高攀岩面，设计可让四人同时攀爬。

sentence_translations.sentence: Quick to set up and pack up, the Mobile Climbing Wall is staffed by qualified and experienced climbing instructors, providing the opportunity to climb the wall in a controlled and safe environment.
sentence_translations.translation: 移动攀岩墙安装和拆卸迅速，由合格且有经验的攀岩教练负责运营，提供在可控且安全的环境中攀爬的机会。

sentence_translations.sentence: When considering what to wear, we've found that trousers and t-shirts are ideal.
sentence_translations.translation: 关于着装，我们发现裤子和T恤是最理想的选择。

sentence_translations.sentence: We will, however, ask people to remove scarves.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，我们会要求人们取下围巾。

sentence_translations.sentence: Most flat shoes are suitable as long as they're enclosed and support the foot.
sentence_translations.translation: 大多数平底鞋都适合，只要它们是包脚且能支撑足部的。

sentence_translations.sentence: The mobile wall is very adaptable and can be operated in light rain and winds up to 50 kph.
sentence_translations.translation: 移动墙适应性很强，可在小雨和风速高达每小时50公里的条件下运行。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are, however, particular measures that we take in such conditions.
sentence_translations.translation: 不过，在这种情况下，我们会采取特定措施。

sentence_translations.sentence: What about hiring the Mobile Climbing Wall for my school or college?
sentence_translations.translation: 租用移动攀岩墙给我的学校或学院怎么样？

sentence_translations.sentence: As climbing is different from the usual team games practised at schools, we've found that some students who don't usually like participating in sports are willing to have a go on the mobile climbing wall.
sentence_translations.translation: 由于攀岩不同于学校常进行的团队运动，我们发现一些通常不喜欢参加体育活动的学生愿意尝试移动攀岩墙。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you're concerned that some children may not want to take part because they feel nervous if they climb, then please be assured that our instructors will support them up to a level which they're comfortable with.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果您担心有些孩子可能因攀爬时感到紧张而不愿参加，请放心，我们的教练会支持他们达到自己感到舒适的程度。

sentence_translations.sentence: They will still benefit greatly from the experience.
sentence_translations.translation: 他们仍将从这次经历中受益匪浅。

paragraphs.text: If you're setting up your own business, here's some advice on getting customers.
paragraphs.translation: 如果你正在创办自己的企业，这里有一些关于获取客户的建议。

paragraphs.text: Know where your customers look
paragraphs.translation: 了解你的客户在哪里寻找信息

paragraphs.text: Your customers aren't necessarily where you think they are.So if you're advertising where they're just not looking, it's wasted money.That's why it pays to do a bit of research. Every time someone contacts your company, ask them where they found out about you.And act on this information so you're advertising in the right places.
paragraphs.translation:
你的客户未必在你以为的地方。
因此，如果你在他们根本不关注的地方做广告，那就是浪费钱。
这就是为什么花点精力做调研是值得的。
每当有人联系你的公司时，问问他们是从哪里了解到你的。
并据此采取行动，确保你在正确的地方投放广告。

paragraphs.text: Always think like a customer
paragraphs.translation: 始终像客户一样思考

paragraphs.text: What makes your customers tick? Find out, and you're halfway to saying the right things in your advertising. So take the time to ask them. A simple phone or email survey of your own customers, politely asking why they use you, what they really like and what they don't, is invaluable.
paragraphs.translation:
是什么驱动着你的客户？
弄清楚这一点，你的广告就能说对一半的话。
因此，花时间去问问他们。
简单地对你的客户进行电话或电子邮件调查，礼貌地询问他们为什么选择你、他们真正喜欢什么以及不喜欢什么，这一点是无价的。

paragraphs.text: Make sure customers know you're there
paragraphs.translation: 确保客户知道你在这里

paragraphs.text: If a customer can't see you, they can't buy from you. There are loads of opportunities to promote your business - print, press, direct mail, telemarketing, email and the internet —and using a mix of these increases your chances of being seen (and remembered).
paragraphs.translation:
如果顾客看不到你，他们就无法从你这里购买。
推广业务的机会有很多——印刷品、新闻媒体、直邮、电话营销、电子邮件和互联网——而综合运用这些方式能提高你被看到（并被记住）的机会。

paragraphs.text: Ignore your customers and they'll go away
paragraphs.translation: 忽视你的客户，他们就会流失。

paragraphs.text: It sounds obvious, but companies who talk to their customers have much better retention rates than those that don't, so it's worth staying in touch. Capture your customers' email addresses upfront. Follow up a transaction to check they're happy with the service and, if possible, send them updates that are helpful, informative and relevant.
paragraphs.translation:
这听起来显而易见，但与客户保持沟通的公司比不这样做的公司拥有更高的客户留存率，因此保持联系是值得的。
尽早获取客户的电子邮件地址。
在交易后跟进，确认他们对服务感到满意，并在可能的情况下，向他们发送有用、信息丰富且相关的最新动态。

paragraphs.text: Know what works (and what doesn't)
paragraphs.translation: 了解有效的方法（以及无效的方法）

paragraphs.text: Do what the professionals do, and measure all your advertising.That'll tell you what you're doing right —and where there's room for improvement. You never know, it might just throw up some information that could change your business for the better.
paragraphs.translation:
效仿专业人士的做法，评估你所有的广告。
这会告诉你哪些地方做得对，以及哪些地方还有改进的空间。
说不定，它可能会提供一些信息，从而让你的业务变得更好。

paragraphs.text: Remember word-of-mouth: the best advertising there is
paragraphs.translation: 记住口碑：这是最好的广告形式

paragraphs.text: A recent survey found that consumers are 50% more likely to be influenced by word-of-mouth recommendations than by TV or radio ads. So your reputation is your greatest asset. If your current customers are impressed with your company, they'll be more inclined to recommend you to others. On the flip side, if they experience bad service they probably won't complain to you - but you can be sure they will to their friends.
paragraphs.translation:
一项最近的调查发现，消费者受口碑推荐影响的可能性比受电视或广播广告影响的可能性高出50%。
因此，你的声誉是你最大的资产。
如果你现有的客户对你的公司印象深刻，他们会更倾向于向他人推荐你。
另一方面，如果他们遭遇糟糕的服务，他们可能不会向你投诉——但你可以肯定他们会向朋友抱怨。

paragraphs.text: Working Time Regulations for Mobile Workers
paragraphs.translation: 流动工人工作时间规定

paragraphs.text: These rules apply to drivers and crew of heavy goods vehicles or public service vehicles. The rules limit the amount of time that can be worked.
paragraphs.translation:
这些规定适用于重型货车或公共服务车辆的司机及乘务人员。
该规定限制了可工作的时长。

paragraphs.text: Those defined in the Regulations as being self-employed are currently not covered by the Regulations.
paragraphs.translation: 目前，该法规不适用于被定义为自雇人士的个体。

paragraphs.text: What are the limits?
paragraphs.translation: 限制条件有哪些？

paragraphs.text: • An average of 48 hours’ work per week.
paragraphs.translation: • 每周平均工作时间为48小时。

paragraphs.text: • In any single week up to 60 hours can be worked so long as the 48-hour average is maintained.
paragraphs.translation: • 在任何单周内，只要保持48小时的平均工时，就可以工作最多60小时。

paragraphs.text: • Night work is limited to 10 hours per night, unless there is a workforce agreement to work longer.
paragraphs.translation: • 夜间工作限制为每晚10小时，除非有员工协议允许更长时间的工作。

paragraphs.text: • Statutory annual leave and any sick leave and/or maternity/paternity leave counts as working time.
paragraphs.translation: • 法定年假以及任何病假和/或产假/陪产假均计入工作时间。

paragraphs.text: What counts as work?
paragraphs.translation: 什么算作工作时间？

paragraphs.text: In general, any activities performed in connection with the transport operation count as work, for example, driving, loading/unloading and those checks that are the responsibility of drivers, such as checking lights, brakes, etc. There are a number of periods of time that do not count as work, for example, travelling between home and your normal place of work, lunch or other breaks and periods of availability.
paragraphs.translation:
总的来说，任何与运输操作相关的活动都算作工作，例如驾驶、装卸以及由司机负责的检查，比如检查车灯、刹车等。
有一些时间段不算作工作，例如在家与正常工作地点之间的通勤、午餐或其他休息时间，以及待命时段。

paragraphs.text: Periods of availability are periods of time during which the mobile worker is not required to remain at their workstation but is required to be available for work, the foreseeable duration of which is known about in advance, for example:
paragraphs.translation: 待命时段是指流动工人不需要留在其工作岗位，但需要随时准备工作的时段，其可预见的持续时间是事先已知的，例如：

paragraphs.text: • Delays at a distribution centre.
paragraphs.translation: • 在配送中心发生的延误。

paragraphs.text: • Reporting for work then being informed that no duties are to be undertaken for a specified period.
paragraphs.translation: • 报到上班后被告知在一段特定时间内无需承担任何工作职责。

paragraphs.text: • Accompanying a vehicle being transported, for example by train.
paragraphs.translation: • 陪同运输中的车辆，例如通过火车。

paragraphs.text: A period of availability can be taken at the workstation.Providing the worker has a reasonable amount of freedom (e.g. they can read and relax) for a known duration, this could satisfy the requirements of a period of availability.
paragraphs.translation:
一段待命时间可以在工作岗位上度过。
只要工人在已知的时间段内拥有合理的自由度（例如他们可以阅读和放松），这就可以满足待命时间的要求。

paragraphs.text: Situations when a period of time should not be recorded as a period of availability:
paragraphs.translation: 不应将一段时间记录为可用时段的几种情况：

paragraphs.text: • Hold-ups due to congestion, because the driver would be stopping and starting the vehicle.
paragraphs.translation: • 因交通拥堵造成的延误，因为司机需要频繁停车和启动车辆。

paragraphs.text: • Frequently moving up within a queue (e.g. waiting within a queue to load or unload) every other minute.
paragraphs.translation: • 每隔一分钟就在队列中频繁向前移动（例如，在排队等待装卸货物时）。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you're setting up your own business, here's some advice on getting customers.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你正在创办自己的企业，这里有一些关于获取客户的建议。

sentence_translations.sentence: Know where your customers look
sentence_translations.translation: 了解你的客户在哪里寻找信息

sentence_translations.sentence: Your customers aren't necessarily where you think they are.
sentence_translations.translation: 你的客户未必在你以为的地方。

sentence_translations.sentence: So if you're advertising where they're just not looking, it's wasted money.
sentence_translations.translation: 因此，如果你在他们根本不关注的地方做广告，那就是浪费钱。

sentence_translations.sentence: That's why it pays to do a bit of research.
sentence_translations.translation: 这就是为什么花点精力做调研是值得的。

sentence_translations.sentence: Every time someone contacts your company, ask them where they found out about you.
sentence_translations.translation: 每当有人联系你的公司时，问问他们是从哪里了解到你的。

sentence_translations.sentence: And act on this information so you're advertising in the right places.
sentence_translations.translation: 并据此采取行动，确保你在正确的地方投放广告。

sentence_translations.sentence: Always think like a customer
sentence_translations.translation: 始终像客户一样思考

sentence_translations.sentence: What makes your customers tick?
sentence_translations.translation: 是什么驱动着你的客户？

sentence_translations.sentence: Find out, and you're halfway to saying the right things in your advertising.
sentence_translations.translation: 弄清楚这一点，你的广告就能说对一半的话。

sentence_translations.sentence: So take the time to ask them.
sentence_translations.translation: 因此，花时间去问问他们。

sentence_translations.sentence: A simple phone or email survey of your own customers, politely asking why they use you, what they really like and what they don't, is invaluable.
sentence_translations.translation: 简单地对你的客户进行电话或电子邮件调查，礼貌地询问他们为什么选择你、他们真正喜欢什么以及不喜欢什么，这一点是无价的。

sentence_translations.sentence: Make sure customers know you're there
sentence_translations.translation: 确保客户知道你在这里

sentence_translations.sentence: If a customer can't see you, they can't buy from you.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果顾客看不到你，他们就无法从你这里购买。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are loads of opportunities to promote your business - print, press, direct mail, telemarketing, email and the internet —and using a mix of these increases your chances of being seen (and remembered).
sentence_translations.translation: 推广业务的机会有很多——印刷品、新闻媒体、直邮、电话营销、电子邮件和互联网——而综合运用这些方式能提高你被看到（并被记住）的机会。

sentence_translations.sentence: Ignore your customers and they'll go away.
sentence_translations.translation: 忽视你的客户，他们就会流失。

sentence_translations.sentence: It sounds obvious, but companies who talk to their customers have much better retention rates than those that don't, so it's worth staying in touch.
sentence_translations.translation: 这听起来显而易见，但与客户保持沟通的公司比不这样做的公司拥有更高的客户留存率，因此保持联系是值得的。

sentence_translations.sentence: Capture your customers' email addresses upfront.
sentence_translations.translation: 尽早获取客户的电子邮件地址。

sentence_translations.sentence: Follow up a transaction to check they're happy with the service and, if possible, send them updates that are helpful, informative and relevant.
sentence_translations.translation: 在交易后跟进，确认他们对服务感到满意，并在可能的情况下，向他们发送有用、信息丰富且相关的最新动态。

sentence_translations.sentence: Know what works (and what doesn't)
sentence_translations.translation: 了解有效的方法（以及无效的方法）

sentence_translations.sentence: Do what the professionals do, and measure all your advertising.
sentence_translations.translation: 效仿专业人士的做法，评估你所有的广告。

sentence_translations.sentence: That'll tell you what you're doing right —and where there's room for improvement.
sentence_translations.translation: 这会告诉你哪些地方做得对，以及哪些地方还有改进的空间。

sentence_translations.sentence: You never know, it might just throw up some information that could change your business for the better.
sentence_translations.translation: 说不定，它可能会提供一些信息，从而让你的业务变得更好。

sentence_translations.sentence: Remember word-of-mouth: the best advertising there is
sentence_translations.translation: 记住口碑：这是最好的广告形式

sentence_translations.sentence: A recent survey found that consumers are 50% more likely to be influenced by word-of-mouth recommendations than by TV or radio ads.
sentence_translations.translation: 一项最近的调查发现，消费者受口碑推荐影响的可能性比受电视或广播广告影响的可能性高出50%。

sentence_translations.sentence: So your reputation is your greatest asset.
sentence_translations.translation: 因此，你的声誉是你最大的资产。

sentence_translations.sentence: If your current customers are impressed with your company, they'll be more inclined to recommend you to others.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你现有的客户对你的公司印象深刻，他们会更倾向于向他人推荐你。

sentence_translations.sentence: On the flip side, if they experience bad service they probably won't complain to you - but you can be sure they will to their friends.
sentence_translations.translation: 另一方面，如果他们遭遇糟糕的服务，他们可能不会向你投诉——但你可以肯定他们会向朋友抱怨。

sentence_translations.sentence: Working Time Regulations for Mobile Workers
sentence_translations.translation: 流动工人工作时间规定

sentence_translations.sentence: These rules apply to drivers and crew of heavy goods vehicles or public service vehicles.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些规定适用于重型货车或公共服务车辆的司机及乘务人员。

sentence_translations.sentence: The rules limit the amount of time that can be worked.
sentence_translations.translation: 该规定限制了可工作的时长。

sentence_translations.sentence: Those defined in the Regulations as being self-employed are currently not covered by the Regulations.
sentence_translations.translation: 目前，该法规不适用于被定义为自雇人士的个体。

sentence_translations.sentence: What are the limits?
sentence_translations.translation: 限制条件有哪些？

sentence_translations.sentence: • An average of 48 hours’ work per week.
sentence_translations.translation: • 每周平均工作时间为48小时。

sentence_translations.sentence: • In any single week up to 60 hours can be worked so long as the 48-hour average is maintained.
sentence_translations.translation: • 在任何单周内，只要保持48小时的平均工时，就可以工作最多60小时。

sentence_translations.sentence: • Night work is limited to 10 hours per night, unless there is a workforce agreement to work longer.
sentence_translations.translation: • 夜间工作限制为每晚10小时，除非有员工协议允许更长时间的工作。

sentence_translations.sentence: • Statutory annual leave and any sick leave and/or maternity/paternity leave counts as working time.
sentence_translations.translation: • 法定年假以及任何病假和/或产假/陪产假均计入工作时间。

sentence_translations.sentence: What counts as work?
sentence_translations.translation: 什么算作工作时间？

sentence_translations.sentence: In general, any activities performed in connection with the transport operation count as work, for example, driving, loading/unloading and those checks that are the responsibility of drivers, such as checking lights, brakes, etc.
sentence_translations.translation: 总的来说，任何与运输操作相关的活动都算作工作，例如驾驶、装卸以及由司机负责的检查，比如检查车灯、刹车等。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are a number of periods of time that do not count as work, for example, travelling between home and your normal place of work, lunch or other breaks and periods of availability.
sentence_translations.translation: 有一些时间段不算作工作，例如在家与正常工作地点之间的通勤、午餐或其他休息时间，以及待命时段。

sentence_translations.sentence: Periods of availability are periods of time during which the mobile worker is not required to remain at their workstation but is required to be available for work, the foreseeable duration of which is known about in advance, for example:
sentence_translations.translation: 待命时段是指流动工人不需要留在其工作岗位，但需要随时准备工作的时段，其可预见的持续时间是事先已知的，例如：

sentence_translations.sentence: • Delays at a distribution centre.
sentence_translations.translation: • 在配送中心发生的延误。

sentence_translations.sentence: • Reporting for work then being informed that no duties are to be undertaken for a specified period.
sentence_translations.translation: • 报到上班后被告知在一段特定时间内无需承担任何工作职责。

sentence_translations.sentence: • Accompanying a vehicle being transported, for example by train.
sentence_translations.translation: • 陪同运输中的车辆，例如通过火车。

sentence_translations.sentence: A period of availability can be taken at the workstation.
sentence_translations.translation: 一段待命时间可以在工作岗位上度过。

sentence_translations.sentence: Providing the worker has a reasonable amount of freedom (e.g. they can read and relax) for a known duration, this could satisfy the requirements of a period of availability.
sentence_translations.translation: 只要工人在已知的时间段内拥有合理的自由度（例如他们可以阅读和放松），这就可以满足待命时间的要求。

sentence_translations.sentence: Situations when a period of time should not be recorded as a period of availability:
sentence_translations.translation: 不应将一段时间记录为可用时段的几种情况：

sentence_translations.sentence: • Hold-ups due to congestion, because the driver would be stopping and starting the vehicle.
sentence_translations.translation: • 因交通拥堵造成的延误，因为司机需要频繁停车和启动车辆。

sentence_translations.sentence: • Frequently moving up within a queue (e.g. waiting within a queue to load or unload) every other minute.
sentence_translations.translation: • 每隔一分钟就在队列中频繁向前移动（例如，在排队等待装卸货物时）。

paragraphs.text: A

An automaton is a machine, usually made to resemble a person or animal, that operates on its own, once it has been started. Although few are constructed nowadays, they have a history stretching back well over two thousand years. Several myths show that the ancient Greeks were interested in the creation of automata. In one, Hephaestus, the god of all mechanical arts, was reputed to have made two female statues of pure gold which assisted him and accompanied him wherever he went. As well as giving automata a place in mythology, the Greeks almost certainly created some.These were probably activated by levers and powered by human action, although there are descriptions of steam and water being used as sources of power.Automata were sometimes intended as toys, or as tools for demonstrating basic scientific principles.
paragraphs.translation:
自动装置是一种机器，通常被制作成模仿人或动物的样子，一旦启动，就能自行运转。
尽管如今很少有人制造它们，但它们的历史可以追溯到两千多年前。
一些神话表明，古希腊人对自动装置的创造很感兴趣。
在一个神话中，所有机械工艺之神赫菲斯托斯据说制作了两尊纯金女性雕像，它们协助他并无论他走到哪里都陪伴着他。
除了在神话中赋予自动装置一席之地外，古希腊人几乎肯定也创造了一些自动装置。
这些装置可能通过杠杆启动并由人力驱动，尽管也有描述提到蒸汽和水被用作动力源。
自动装置有时被用作玩具，或者作为演示基本科学原理的工具。

paragraphs.text: B

Other ancient cultures, too, seem to have developed automata. In Egypt, Ctesibius experimented with air pressure and pneumatic principles. One of his creations was a singing blackbird powered by water. A Chinese text of the third century BC describes a life-size, human-shaped figure that could walk rapidly, move its head up and down, sing and wink its eye.
paragraphs.translation:
其他古代文化似乎也发展了自动机。
在埃及，克特西比乌斯对气压和气动原理进行了实验。
他的一个作品是一只用水力驱动的会唱歌的黑鹂。
公元前三世纪的一部中文文献描述了一个真人大小的人形雕像，它能快速行走、上下移动头部、唱歌并眨眼。
其他古代文明似乎也发展出了自动机。
他的一个发明是一只由水力驱动的会唱歌的黑鹂。
公元前三世纪的一部中国文献描述了一个真人大小的人形装置，它能快速行走、上下移动头部、唱歌并眨眼。

paragraphs.text: C

Much later, Arab engineers of the ninth and thirteenth centuries wrote detailed treatises on how to build programmable musical fountains, mechanical servants, and elaborate clocks. A ninth-century ruler in Baghdad had a silver and gold tree with metal birds that sang.The art of creating automata developed considerably during the fifteenth century, linked with improvements in clock making: the mechanisms of automata and clocks had a great deal in common. Some truly remarkable automata were produced at this time. Muller was reputed to have made an artificial eagle which flew to greet the Emperor on his entry into Nuremberg, Germany, in 1470, then returned to perch on top of a city gate and, by stretching its wings and bowing, saluted the emperor on his arrival. Leonardo da Vinci made a lion in honour of the king of France, which advanced towards him, stopped, opened its chest with a claw and pointed to the French coat of arms.
paragraphs.translation:
很久之后，9世纪和13世纪的阿拉伯工程师撰写了详细的论文，论述如何建造可编程的音乐喷泉、机械仆人和精致的钟表。
一位9世纪巴格达的统治者拥有一棵金银制成的树，上面有会唱歌的金属鸟。
随着钟表制造技术的改进，自动机制造艺术在15世纪得到了显著发展：自动机与钟表的机械装置有许多共同之处。
这一时期制造出了一些真正非凡的自动机。
据传，穆勒制造了一只人造鹰，它在1470年皇帝进入德国纽伦堡时飞过去迎接，然后返回栖息在城门顶上，通过伸展翅膀并鞠躬，在皇帝抵达时向其致敬。
莱昂纳多·达·芬奇为向法国国王致敬制作了一头狮子，它走向国王，停下来，用爪子打开胸膛，并指向法国的盾形徽章。

paragraphs.text: D

Automata were normally very expensive toys for the very rich. They were made for royal or aristocratic patrons, to be viewed only by themselves and selected guests - who were expected to be impressed by their wealth. Automata were also created for public show, however, and many appeared on clock towers, such as the one in Bern, Switzerland, built in 1530.
paragraphs.translation:
自动机通常是专为极其富有的人准备的非常昂贵的玩具。
它们是为王室或贵族赞助人而制造的，仅供他们本人和特定的宾客观看——这些宾客预计会为他们的财富所打动。
然而，自动机也被用于公开表演，许多出现在钟楼上，例如建于1530年的瑞士伯尔尼钟楼上的自动机。
自动机通常是为富人准备的价格极为昂贵的玩具。
它们是为皇室或贵族赞助人制造的，仅供他们本人和特定宾客观赏——这些人应该会因赞助人的财富而感到印象深刻。
然而，自动机也被制作出来用于公开表演，许多出现在钟楼上，例如瑞士伯尔尼于1530年建造的那座钟楼上的自动机。

paragraphs.text: E

During the eighteenth century, some watchmakers made automata to contribute to the progress of medicine and the natural sciences, particularly to investigate the mechanical laws governing the structure and movement of living things. Many of their creations simulated almost perfectly the complex structure of human beings and animals. Maillardet made extensive use of gearing and cogs to produce automata of horses, worked by turning a handle. Vaucanson produced a duck made of gilded copper which ate, drank and quacked like a real duck. He also made a life-size female flute player.Air passes through the complex mechanism, causing the lips and fingers of the player to move naturally on the flute, opening and closing holes on it.This automaton had a repertoire of twelve tunes.
paragraphs.translation:
在18世纪，一些钟表匠制作自动机器以促进医学和自然科学的发展，特别是为了研究支配生物结构和运动的机械法则。
他们的许多作品几乎完美地模拟了人类和动物的复杂结构。
马亚尔代广泛利用齿轮和嵌齿制作了马匹自动机器，通过转动手柄来驱动。
沃康松制作了一只镀金铜鸭，它能像真鸭子一样进食、饮水和嘎嘎叫。
他还制作了一个真人大小的女性长笛演奏者。
空气穿过复杂的机械装置，使演奏者的嘴唇和手指在长笛上自然移动，开合其上的孔眼。
这个自动机器能演奏十二首曲目。
在18世纪，一些钟表匠制造自动机以促进医学和自然科学的发展，特别是用于研究支配生物结构和运动的机械规律。
马亚尔代大量使用齿轮和嵌齿来制造通过转动把手驱动的马形自动机。
沃康松制造了一只镀金铜鸭，它能像真鸭子一样进食、饮水并发出嘎嘎叫声。
空气通过复杂的机械装置，使演奏者的嘴唇和手指在长笛上自然移动，从而开合其上的音孔。
这个自动机能够演奏十二首曲目。

paragraphs.text: F

In another well-known piece,Merlin's silver swan made in 1773, the swan sits in a stream consisting of glass rods where small silver fish are swimming. When the clockwork is wound, a music box plays and the glass rods rotate, giving the impression of a flowing stream. The swan turns its head from side to side. It soon notices the fish and bends down to catch and eat one, then raises its head to the upright position.The mechanism still works.
paragraphs.translation:
在另一件著名的作品中，即1773年制造的梅林银天鹅，天鹅坐在一条由玻璃棒组成的小溪中，溪中有银色小鱼在游动。
当发条装置上紧后，音乐盒开始演奏，玻璃棒旋转起来，营造出溪水流动的视觉效果。
天鹅左右转动着它的头。
它很快注意到鱼，便弯下腰捕捉并吃掉一条，然后抬起头恢复到竖直位置。
这个机械装置至今仍能运作。

paragraphs.text: G

One of the most skilled makers of automata was the Swiss watchmaker Jaquet-Droz.He produced three automata which, even today, are considered wonders of science and mechanical engineering.One of these,The Writer, simulates a boy sitting at a desk, dipping his pen into the ink and writing perfectly legibly.
paragraphs.translation:
最技艺精湛的自动机工匠之一是瑞士钟表匠雅凯-德罗。
他制造了三台自动机，即便在今天，它们仍被视为科学和机械工程的奇迹。
其中一台名为《作家》，模拟了一个男孩坐在书桌前，将笔浸入墨水并书写出完全清晰的文字。

paragraphs.text: H

Another stunning creation of the eighteenth century was the Mechanical Theatre in the grounds of Austria's Hellbrunn Palace, home of the Archbishop of Salzburg. Designed by the miner Rosenegger, and completed in 1752, this depicts the nobility's idea of a perfect society, with every class in its proper place. The figures inside a palace depict eighteenth-century court life, while industrious activity is carried on in and around this building.A total of 141 mobile and 52 immobile little figures demonstrate all manner of trades of the period:building workers bring materials to the foreman, who drinks; butchers slaughter an ox; a barber shaves a man.A dancing bear performs, guards march past the palace, a farmer pushes an old woman in a wheelbarrow over the road.The theatre shows great skill in clock making and water technology, consisting of hidden waterwheels, copper wiring and cogwheels.
paragraphs.translation:
十八世纪的另一项惊人创造是位于奥地利海尔布伦宫（萨尔茨堡大主教住所）庭园内的机械剧场。
由矿工罗森埃格设计，并于1752年完工，该作品描绘了贵族心目中的理想社会，每个阶层都处于其应有的位置。
宫殿内的人物展现了十八世纪的宫廷生活，而这座建筑内外则进行着勤劳的活动。
共计141个可移动和52个不可移动的小人偶展示了那个时代各式各样的行业：建筑工人向正在喝酒的工头运送材料；屠夫宰杀一头公牛；理发师为一名男子刮脸。
一只跳舞的熊在表演，卫兵列队走过宫殿，一名农夫推着手推车，车上坐着一位老妇人，穿过道路。
该剧场展现了制钟和水力技术方面的精湛技艺，由隐藏的水轮、铜线和齿轮构成。

paragraphs.text: I

During the nineteenth century, mass production techniques meant that automata could be made cheaply and easily, and they became toys for children rather than an expensive adult amusement. Between 1860 and 1910, small family businesses in Paris made thousands of clockwork automata and mechanical singing birds and exported them around the world. However, the twentieth century saw traditional forms of automata fall out of favour.

在19世纪，大规模生产技术意味着自动装置可以廉价且容易地制造出来，它们变成了儿童的玩具，而非昂贵的成人娱乐品。
在1860年至1910年间，巴黎的小型家族企业制造了数千个发条自动装置和机械唱歌鸟，并将它们出口到世界各地。
然而，20世纪见证了传统形式的自动装置失宠。

sentence_translations.sentence: The mechanism still works.
sentence_translations.translation: 这个机械装置至今仍能运作。

sentence_translations.sentence: One of the most skilled makers of automata was the Swiss watchmaker Jaquet-Droz.
sentence_translations.translation: 最技艺精湛的自动机工匠之一是瑞士钟表匠雅凯-德罗。

sentence_translations.sentence: He produced three automata which, even today, are considered wonders of science and mechanical engineering.
sentence_translations.translation: 他制造了三台自动机，即便在今天，它们仍被视为科学和机械工程的奇迹。

sentence_translations.sentence: One of these, The Writer, simulates a boy sitting at a desk, dipping his pen into the ink and writing perfectly legibly.
sentence_translations.translation: 其中一台名为《作家》，模拟了一个男孩坐在书桌前，将笔浸入墨水并书写出完全清晰的文字。

sentence_translations.sentence: Another stunning creation of the eighteenth century was the Mechanical Theatre in the grounds of Austria's Hellbrunn Palace, home of the Archbishop of Salzburg.
sentence_translations.translation: 十八世纪的另一项惊人创造是位于奥地利海尔布伦宫（萨尔茨堡大主教住所）庭园内的机械剧场。

sentence_translations.sentence: Designed by the miner Rosenegger, and completed in 1752, this depicts the nobility's idea of a perfect society, with every class in its proper place.
sentence_translations.translation: 由矿工罗森埃格设计，并于1752年完工，该作品描绘了贵族心目中的理想社会，每个阶层都处于其应有的位置。

sentence_translations.sentence: The figures inside a palace depict eighteenth-century court life, while industrious activity is carried on in and around this building.
sentence_translations.translation: 宫殿内的人物展现了十八世纪的宫廷生活，而这座建筑内外则进行着勤劳的活动。

sentence_translations.sentence: A total of 141 mobile and 52 immobile little figures demonstrate all manner of trades of the period:building workers bring materials to the foreman, who drinks; butchers slaughter an ox; a barber shaves a man.
sentence_translations.translation: 共计141个可移动和52个不可移动的小人偶展示了那个时代各式各样的行业：建筑工人向正在喝酒的工头运送材料；屠夫宰杀一头公牛；理发师为一名男子刮脸。

sentence_translations.sentence: A dancing bear performs, guards march past the palace, a farmer pushes an old woman in a wheelbarrow over the road.
sentence_translations.translation: 一只跳舞的熊在表演，卫兵列队走过宫殿，一名农夫推着手推车，车上坐着一位老妇人，穿过道路。

sentence_translations.sentence: The theatre shows great skill in clock making and water technology, consisting of hidden waterwheels, copper wiring and cogwheels.
sentence_translations.translation: 该剧场展现了制钟和水力技术方面的精湛技艺，由隐藏的水轮、铜线和齿轮构成。

sentence_translations.sentence: During the nineteenth century, mass production techniques meant that automata could be made cheaply and easily, and they became toys for children rather than an expensive adult amusement.
sentence_translations.translation: 在19世纪，大规模生产技术意味着自动装置可以廉价且容易地制造出来，它们变成了儿童的玩具，而非昂贵的成人娱乐品。

sentence_translations.sentence: Between 1860 and 1910, small family businesses in Paris made thousands of clockwork automata and mechanical singing birds and exported them around the world.
sentence_translations.translation: 在1860年至1910年间，巴黎的小型家族企业制造了数千个发条自动装置和机械唱歌鸟，并将它们出口到世界各地。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, the twentieth century saw traditional forms of automata fall out of favour.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，20世纪见证了传统形式的自动装置失宠。
